source_document: Real Decreto 773/2014, normas reguladoras del trasvase por el acueducto Tajo-Segura (art. 1: monthly volumes set by the joint storage of Entrepeñas and Buendía)
notes: The transfer takes Tajo water stored in Entrepeñas and Buendía (intake at Bolarque); what it may send each month depends on their joint storage.
